messages:
maria: Hey @channel — customer (acct-acme) reports 403 when trying to open a project from the console. They can see the org, but clicking into Project → Settings gives: 403 Permission Denied. Occurs after SSO (Okta) login. Ticket TICKET-4321. Request-id: req_63f2-172. Screenshot: https://files.acme/snap.png

josh (acct-acme): Confirming — user logged in via SSO, able to view org list, but when selecting project 'acme-app' they get a generic 403 page. API still works with API key. User is in Okta group `acme-devs` mapped to `Project Admin` via SCIM.

maria: Repro steps I ran: create org, enable SSO enforce, add user via SCIM mapping to Project Admin, login as user -> click project -> 403. Console logs show auth check failing at permissions service. Minimal repro curl shown below.

maria: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <session_token>" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/123/projects/456/overview
# => 403 Forbidden, body: {"error":"forbidden","reason":"insufficient_project_role"}
```

ethan (Eng): Thanks — can you paste the request-id from the failing call and confirm deployment type (hosted/dedicated/private)? Also does the user have any org-level role assigned?

maria: Request-id above (req_63f2-172). Customer is on Hosted. No explicit org-level role; user only has project-level mapping via Okta->SCIM group.

ethan (Eng): I pulled traces for req_63f2-172. Permission check is hitting our Permissions Service which returns 404 on role lookup: `role_not_found` for project role id. Looks like when SSO is enforced and SCIM creates roles, the project-role lookup occasionally fails to fall back to the org-level role mapping. Suspect regression from the recent role-refactor.

sara (SRE): I see a spike of similar 403s from yesterday after deploy rel-2.4.7. Filtering logs: candidate pattern -> `permissions: lookup project_role -> nil -> error`. Affected region: us-west-2.

maria: Quick question — grant the user an org role to test? (Org Admin or Org Viewer)

josh (acct-acme): I temporarily added Org Viewer to the user — still 403. Then I tried Org Admin and that worked (user can access project). Not ideal to make them Org Admin.

ethan (Eng): That behavior helps — indicates the check path uses org role only if it's Org Admin specifically, bug there. I'll put up a patch to fall back to org roles consistently and handle nil project-roles gracefully. Will try to push a hotfix to prod; ETA ~15min.

maria: Adding logs & repro to the ticket and escalating to Tier 2. Attaching debug trace snippet: `trace: perms_service.v1.Check -> projectId=456 userId=789 status=404 role_lookup=nil`

ethan (Eng): Pushing a tiny change to permissions resolution: if `project_role == nil` then attempt `org_role` lookup; also guard against nil pointer. Creating release rel-2.4.9, will promote to prod after smoke.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted rel-2.4.9 -> production (us-west-2) | sha: abcdef123456 | start: 2025-10-04T17:12:00Z

sara (SRE): Observability note — added alert for "permission lookup nil" threshold.

maria: @josh can you ask your user to try again in ~10-15m? I'll keep ticket open.

josh (acct-acme): Will do.

~15m later...

josh (acct-acme): Tried now — access restored, no more 403. Verified project settings load and Settings > Members shows correct role mapping. Thanks! :tada:

maria: Great — marking TICKET-4321 as resolved. Workaround summary added to KB: "If console returns 403 for SSO-only users, grant a transient Org Admin or wait for fix; permanent fix rolled in rel-2.4.9."

ethan (Eng): Follow-up: will open a PR to add a unit test around role fallback and schedule a canary job to verify SSO-enforced orgs in staging.

maria: Closing thread once KB entry reviewed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
